name: Mendhak Hop: Lotus Pond Subtraction
domain: Subtraction by Counting Up on a Number Line
competency: Understanding subtraction as the forward distance between two numbers by hopping along friendly benchmark lily pads (friendly tens and hundreds)
ncertStandard: NCERT Grade 2 & 3 Mathematics: Joyful Mathematics Chapter 6 (Mendhak ki Chhalang - Jump Strategy)
overview: At the tranquil village lotus pond (Kamal Talab), children help Mendhak Raja the friendly frog hop forward from the smaller number to the bigger destination across floating lily pads. By making quick leaps to friendly tens and hundreds, children discover that adding up the frog hops reveals the exact subtraction answer without confusing borrowing.
learningOutcomes: Understand subtraction as forward distance across a number line / pond path
Identify and hop to nearest friendly benchmark numbers (e.g. 14 -> 20 -> 50)
Combine unit hops and ten hops to calculate multi-digit differences mentally
Connect hop additions (+6 and +30) with the subtraction equation (50 - 14 = 36)
Freely explore jump combinations in the interactive Lotus Pond Sandbox mode

levels.name: Little Froggy Hops (Within 30)
levels.description: Gentle introduction: hop to friendly 20 or 30 with numbers up to 30

levels.name: Lily Pad Trail (Within 60)
levels.description: Two-hop journey: units to friendly 10, then tens to target (e.g. 36 -> 40 -> 50)

levels.name: Century Leap (Hop to 100)
levels.description: Hop to friendly ten, then giant leap to 100 (e.g. 64 -> 70 -> 100)
